Hi all,

Thanks again for the interest in a focused technical deep-dive on inference serving with Redwood. The goal for this session is to walk through an end-to-end best-practice for multi-tenant burst behavior, autoscaling policies, and a short live demo of batching/caching improvements.

Proposed duration: 60 minutes (40 min presentation + 20 min Q&A)
Proposed window: Thursday 11/05, 5:30–6:30 PM PT — this time lets our APAC folks be out of core hours and works for a couple of EU attendees.

Agenda (attached):
- Introductions & goals (5 min)
- Architecture patterns for production inference (15 min)
- Live run: autoscaling + cache hits (12 min)
- Cost/latency tradeoffs and tuning knobs (8 min)
- Q&A + next steps (20 min)

Action items: I’ll send a calendar invite once we confirm attendance. Please reply with any hard constraints or if you need a morning alternative.

Attachments: agenda_q4_deep_dive.pdf (2 pages)

Thanks,
Rohan

Hi everyone — final update after internal scheduling: we moved the session 20 minutes earlier to accommodate QuantumRetail’s exec window. New confirmed time: Thursday 11/05, 5:15–6:15 PM PT. Apologies for the short shuffle — we tried to avoid splitting the cohort.

Attached: agenda_q4_deep_dive.pdf (final) and evening-deep-dive.ics (calendar invite). Also included a short pre-read on the quantization profile and perf expectations (2 paragraphs below).

Pre-read (brief):
- Demo model: open Llama derivative, FP16 / 4-bit quantized variant with KV-cache preserved across prefixes. Expect a ~1.8x token throughput improvement vs FP16 baseline in continuous-batch mode.
- Tuning note: for short-turn conversations (≤128 tokens) set batching max latency to 30ms to avoid throughput-induced tail latency.

Call flow: Laura will open with intro and architecture context (5:15–5:30), Ben will run the live demo (5:30–5:50), Rohan will cover cost/latency tradeoffs (5:50–6:05), then 10 mins of live Q&A and wrap.

Links: Google Calendar invite — https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-evening-deep-dive

Thanks all — see you Thursday.
